A bill for an act relating to corrections; limiting strip searches in state correctional facilities; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 243.48, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 243.48, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 3.+]

[+Search of incarcerated person incident to contact with visitor.+]

[+The chief executive officer of a state correctional facility may, pursuant to rules adopted by the commissioner, authorize the use of a body scanner or other minimally invasive methods to screen an incarcerated person before or following a meeting with a visitor. A strip search of an incarcerated person before or following a meeting with a visitor is prohibited unless there is a credible, documented security concern to justify a strip search. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to corrections; limiting strip searches in state correctional facilities; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 243.48, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 243.48, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 3.

Search of incarcerated person incident to contact with visitor.

The chief executive officer of a state correctional facility may, pursuant to rules adopted by the commissioner, authorize the use of a body scanner or other minimally invasive methods to screen an incarcerated person before or following a meeting with a visitor. A strip search of an incarcerated person before or following a meeting with a visitor is prohibited unless there is a credible, documented security concern to justify a strip search.
